svg.text: One lap, deployed policy, coloured by speed (10.2-28.7 m/s)
The baseline (tv_mode=none) car drove 7,000 m of Spa (100% of the lap), without leaving the road. Speed spans
envelope_penalty=3/exponent=2, tv_mode='none', seed 1 (drive seed 0), Spa via tracks_data.load_real_track, offset-free tire. Rung 2 of the
fidelity ladder (double-track): per-wheel loads and load transfer, no roll camber, roll steer or compliance.
